name: io.github.tonyyang0504/snapchat-mcp
description: Snapchat Ads (Snapchat Ads Manager) (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, pause_resu

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SNAPCHAT_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth client id of your Snap Business Manager app (Business Details > OAuth apps).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SNAPCHAT_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The OAuth app's client secret (form body of the refresh request).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SNAPCHAT_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token from one authorization-code consent with scope snapchat-marketing-api (https://developers.snap.com/api/marketing-api/Ads-API/authentication); 60-minute access tokens are minted from it.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SNAPCHAT_ORGANIZATION_ID
environmentVariables.description: Snap organization id whose ad accounts list_accounts returns (GET /v1/me/organizations).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SNAPCHAT_AD_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Ad account id used by pause_resume (the campaign PATCH path is /v1/adaccounts/{ad_account_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SNAPCHAT_TZ_OFFSET
environmentVariables.description: UTC offset of the ad account time zone, e.g. -07:00 or +01:00, used to build day-aligned start_time/end_time for get_report (Snap requires daily boundaries in the account time zone).
